Reflection pool centred roughly x~0.4-0.6. Best seconds 2-12. Foreground motion blur at the bottom edge. fact_en: Badwater Basin is the lowest point in North America at 282 ft (86 m) below sea level. The salt flats here cover nearly 200 square miles (518 square km).
